app_banking_description: Access your funds here whenever you're in a town.
app_contacts_description: Call your friends and battle the people of your choice.
app_map_description: Use this on your phone to see where you are.
app_radio_description: Tune in to local broadcasts, quest updates, and ambient chatter from across the region.
app_renaming_description: Give your Tuxemon a fresh identity with a new name—make it truly yours!
app_tuxepedia_description: Keep track of information about Tuxemon here, and share it with the world.
asterchip_description: A small curious rock. The asteroid belt lies between Mars and Jupiter.
astercrab_description: A rock-armored armadillo. Asteroids are leftovers from when the planets formed.
asterfort_description: A fortress on four legs. Most asteroids are tiny compared with a planet.
aurorail_description: A tail of glow. Auroras appear when the solar wind hits our air.
cant_release: Can't release only Tuxemon in party.
classic_gym_leader_granite_post: Heh… even mountains crumble someday. You've earned this victory, challenger.
classic_gym_leader_granite_pre: You've climbed all the way here? Good. Let's see if your spirit is as solid as the stones beneath us.
classic_gym_leader_mila_post: Wow! You're full of surprises. That was a really fun match!
classic_gym_leader_mila_pre: Let's keep this friendly, okay? But don't think I'll go easy on you!
combat_cannot_run_away: Your run attempt failed this time.
combat_clone_description: They begin to divide themselves and send the copy to attack.
combat_full_health: But {name} is already at full health.
combat_horde_appeared: A horde of wild creatures surrounds you!
combat_splash_partial: A partial hit! Reduced damage was dealt.
combat_state_charmed_get: {target} is charmed and might hesitate to act.
combat_state_confused_tech: {target} gets muddled and does not use {name}!
combat_state_diehard_end: {target} is too injured to gain Diehard.
combat_state_feedback_get: {target} is turning ranged attacks back on the attacker.
combat_state_festering_item: The healing fails. The wound festers.
combat_state_harpooned_get: {target} risks injury if it backs away.
combat_state_lockdown_item: Items cannot be used on {target} while it is locked down.
combat_state_plague1: Ah ... Ah. {target} held in a sneeze.
combat_state_prickly_get: {target} is harmful to make contact with.
combat_state_retaliate_get: {target} will retaliate on its next attack.
combat_state_spiky_get: {target} risks injury if it steps in.
combat_state_wasting_get: {target} is afflicted by a wasting condition.
combit_description: A little icy cloud with a tail. A comet is a lump of ice and dust.
cometail_description: A small dragon with a tail. Near the Sun a comet's ice melts and forms its tail.
cometrail_description: A long glowing trail. A comet's tail always points away from the Sun.
crystal_description: The user fires a sharp, crystalline projectile at the opponent.
divinity_beam_description: A ray of divinity blinds those who look upon it.
dustip_description: A speck of dust. Space dust scatters sunlight.
europan_description: Guardian of the deep. The ocean under Europa's ice is very deep.
europip_description: A small cool fish. Under Europa's ice there may be an ocean.
europod_description: An ice turtle. Europa is a moon of Jupiter.
ganybit_description: A big greyish ball. Ganymede is the biggest moon in the Solar System.
ganyguard_description: A guardian with a shield. Ganymede has a magnetic field of its own.
ganyhorn_description: A bison with icy horns. Ganymede is bigger than the planet Mercury.
gotcha_kennel: {name} has been put in the kennel!
gravip_description: A little ball that circles around. Gravity is a pull between things.
gravivault_description: Guardian of the orbits. Gravity keeps the Moon circling Earth.
heliarch_description: Its crown glows like the Sun's corona, which we see only during a solar eclipse.
heliobud_description: A tiny glowing star. The Sun is a star, and its light reaches us in about 8 minutes.
heliolynx_description: A warm, happy flame cat. The Sun is very hot, so we never look straight at it.
iobud_description: A yellow, spotted ball. Io is a moon of Jupiter with many volcanoes.
iolisk_description: A speckled lizard. Io's volcanoes spray out gas and hot rock.
iopyre_description: A glowing lizard. Io is the most volcanic place in the Solar System.
item_no_available_target: {name} cannot be used on any of your Tuxemon right now.
item_used_wrong_location_type: {name} can only be used in a {here}!
jovibud_description: A striped ball. Jupiter is the biggest planet.
jovigale_description: Stormy and bold. Jupiter is mostly gas, with no ground to stand on.
jovihog_description: A little cloud piglet. Jupiter has a giant storm, the Great Red Spot, for centuries.
kuipcrest_description: Quills of ice crystals. Some comets come from there.
kuipine_description: An ice hedgehog. The Kuiper belt holds many frozen bodies.
kuipip_description: A little ball of ice. The Kuiper belt lies far away, beyond Neptune.
lunibble_description: A small round moon. The Moon makes no light of its own, it shines with the Sun's light.
lunihare_description: This hare jumps high, because gravity on the Moon is weak.
lunwarden_description: It guards the craters. Each crater was made when a space rock fell on the Moon.
marskip_description: A bouncy lizard. Mars has a giant volcano called Olympus Mons.
marstrix_description: A brave red knight. Robots are already exploring the surface of Mars.
menu_no_craftable_items: You can't craft anything right now.
menu_park_afraid: {user} recoils, its body tense and ready to flee.
menu_park_playful: {user} dashes around, kicking up dust in excitement.
menu_park_resting: {user} curls up, its breath slow and steady.
menu_park_stare: {user} fixes its gaze on you, unreadable and still.
menu_park_wander: {user} moves slowly, lost in thought or instinct.
menu_storage_empty_kennel: This shelter is empty, there are no monsters to take.
menu_storage_empty_locker: This locker is empty, there are no items to take.
menu_storage_infected_monster: Virus detected. For the safety of all tuxemon in our system, you cannot store an infected tuxemon.
menu_storage_items_full: Your bag is full, you cannot take any more from storage.
menu_storage_swap_monster: The drone completed the transfer: {from} is now in storage, and {to} has joined your party.
menu_storage_swap_monster_fail: The drone could not complete the transfer: no monsters are available in the kennel.
mercuram_description: A strong rocky ram. Mercury is very hot by day and very cold at night.
mercurip_description: A small cratered rock. Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.
mercurush_description: A quick lizard. A year on Mercury lasts only 88 days, so everything runs fast.
meteet_description: A small glowing rock. A meteor is a streak of light made when a rock enters the air.
meteohelm_description: A stag with blazing antlers. A meteor that lands on the ground is called a meteorite.
meteoroar_description: A fox with a fiery tail. What we call a falling star is a meteor, not a star.
nagmon_ai_how_to_keys: To add a key: run 'python -m nagmon.keys_cli set groq KEY' on this computer, or set GROQ_API_KEY.
nagmon_ai_no_keys: No AI key is set. The owl answers from its ready answers.
nagmon_badge_granite_description: Granite Academy badge. Given for knowing shapes and a friendly duel.
nagmon_badge_mila_description: Mila Academy badge. Given for practising math and a friendly duel.
nagmon_celebration_saved: Saved. We will tell you when it is earned.
nagmon_celebration_title_prompt: What is the celebration? (only parents see it)
nagmon_confirm_pin_prompt:
Parent code
Type the same 4 digits again.
nagmon_github_bad_token: The token is wrong or has expired. Create a new token on GitHub and paste it again.
nagmon_github_clipboard_empty: The clipboard is empty. On GitHub create a fine-grained token for the data repo only, with one permission: Contents: Read and write. Copy it, come back here and tap again.
nagmon_github_clipboard_not_token: The clipboard holds something that is not a GitHub token. Copy the token (it starts with github_pat_) and try again.
nagmon_github_confirm_crash: To be sent: the last crash report, without keys, to the private data repo {repo}.
nagmon_github_confirm_log: To be sent: the game's log, without keys, to the private data repo {repo}.
nagmon_github_confirm_progress: To be sent: progress of {count} children, without names, to the private data repo {repo}.
nagmon_github_confirm_progress_one: To be sent: progress of one child, without the name, to the private data repo {repo}.
nagmon_github_conflict: GitHub was busy and did not save the file. Try again in a minute.
nagmon_github_disconnected: Disconnected. The token was deleted from this device.
nagmon_github_failed: GitHub did not accept the request. Try again later.
nagmon_github_log_empty: There is no log to send yet.
nagmon_github_no_permission: The token has no Contents: Read and write permission for {repo}. Add it in the token's settings on GitHub and try again.
nagmon_github_not_connected: Not connected. Sending needs a GitHub token for the data repo. Tap Connect: paste token.
nagmon_github_not_found: The data repo {repo} was not found, or the token may not use it. Choose this repo in the token's settings on GitHub and try again.
nagmon_github_offline: No internet. Connect to a network and try again.
nagmon_github_public: The data repo {repo} is public, so nothing is sent. On GitHub open the repo's Settings, choose Private under Change visibility, and try again.
nagmon_github_timeout: GitHub did not answer in time. Check the internet and try again.
nagmon_github_where: Paste the token in the parent area: "Send data to the developer (GitHub)".
nagmon_name_invalid: Use 1 to 16 Hebrew or English letters.
nagmon_order_hint: Tap the items in the right order
nagmon_owl_cape:
Wise Owl: And look what I got, a blue cape for your badge!
I will wear it proudly. We took this step together.
nagmon_owl_congrats_granite:
Wise Owl: I saw what happened at the academy!
You answered questions about shapes and kept going in the duel.
Look, the color is coming back to the town. That's your knowledge!
nagmon_owl_congrats_mila:
Wise Owl: Another badge! You practised math until it worked.
The fog moved back a little more.
nagmon_owl_first_good:
Very nice! You thought it all the way through.
That's how knowledge power charges up.
nagmon_owl_first_q:
Let's try one question together.
No clock and no rush. Take your time.
nagmon_owl_first_wrong:
No problem! Mistakes are part of learning.
Now we already know something new.
nagmon_owl_gifts:
Here are 5 capture balls and 3 potions.
Monsters live in the tall grass on Route 1. You can make friends with them.
nagmon_owl_go:
The people in town need help, and each of them teaches something.
Route 1 starts at the north of town.
The yellow building on the right is the Granite Academy. The master waits there.
And if your monsters are tired, come to me.
nagmon_owl_heal:
Your monsters rested and drank some water.
They are full of power again!
nagmon_owl_intro_power:
This is called knowledge power. Here is how it works:
In a duel you can answer a question before a move. A right answer makes the move stronger!
You can always attack without a question too.
And a mistake? That's fine. The move is a normal one, and I will explain.
nagmon_owl_intro_starter:
Three little monsters are waiting for a friend.
Heliobud is a sun monster. It loves math.
Terrabub is an earth monster. It loves shapes.
Lunibble is a moon monster. It loves science.
Who will be your first friend?
nagmon_owl_intro_story:
Wise Owl: Hello, ${{name}}! I'm glad you came.
A grey fog fell on our world. It is called the Fog of Forgetting.
Whoever it touches forgets: numbers, words, shapes.
Even the monsters forgot their powers, and the world is losing its colors.
But there is a way to bring it all back: knowledge! Everything we learn gives power back.
nagmon_owl_picked_heliobud:
Heliobud jumps for joy!
When it attacks, the questions will be about math.
nagmon_owl_picked_lunibble:
Lunibble glows a little with joy.
When it attacks, the questions will be about science.
nagmon_owl_picked_terrabub:
Terrabub hums quietly.
When it attacks, the questions will be about shapes.
nagmon_owl_tip_all:
Two badges! Steady, beautiful work.
The fog has moved back a little from the town. The adventure is only beginning.
nagmon_owl_tip_granite:
Tip: the master's test has 3 questions about shapes.
Two right answers are enough. And you can try again as often as you like.
nagmon_owl_tip_mila:
Your Stone Badge is shining!
Next to the Granite Academy there is another one: Mila, the math academy.
nagmon_pin_locked: Too many tries. Please wait {seconds} seconds.
nagmon_pin_mismatch: The codes are not the same. Starting again.
nagmon_pin_prompt:
Parent code
Type the parent code (4 digits).
nagmon_player_deleted: {name} was moved to the trash. You can restore it.
nagmon_restore_failed: This player can't come back right now: another player has the same name, or there are already 8 players.
nagmon_set_pin_prompt:
Parent code
Choose 4 digits. The code guards the parent area and adding players.
nagmon_share_log_failed: Could not open the share window.
nagmon_solar_giants_moon_engineer: Jupiter has dozens of moons. Ganymede, the biggest, is even bigger across than Mercury. Europa, another moon of Jupiter, is covered with ice.
nagmon_solar_giants_owl: There is no ground to stand on at Jupiter: it is mostly gas. It has a giant red storm, seen for more than a hundred years.
nagmon_solar_giants_sage: Jupiter is the biggest planet. Saturn has rings of ice and rock. Both are made mostly of gas.
nagmon_solar_giants_sage_ask: A riddle for you: I have beautiful rings of ice and rock, and I am the sixth planet from the Sun. Who am I? We will find the answer after one question.
nagmon_solar_giants_sage_good: Right! And the answer to the riddle: Saturn, the planet with the rings. Here are 18 coins.
nagmon_solar_giants_sage_wrong: No problem! Now we saw the answer. And the answer to the riddle: Saturn, the planet with the rings. You can try again.
nagmon_solar_moon_moon_engineer: I am the Moon engineer. The Moon has no air, so there is no wind and no sound. It is full of craters, made when rocks from space hit it.
nagmon_solar_moon_moon_engineer_ask: I am writing the craters in my log, and there are so many. Will you help me with one question?
nagmon_solar_moon_moon_engineer_good: Right! The craters are in the log. Here are 10 coins for your help.
nagmon_solar_moon_owl: The Moon makes no light of its own. We see sunlight coming back from it. The Moon goes around the Earth about once a month.
nagmon_solar_outer_grey_hood: It is far and cold out here. Uranus and Neptune are ice giants. Sunlight takes about four hours to reach Neptune.
nagmon_solar_outer_grey_hood_ask: I have three cards from the edge of the system. Take a look at them, and then one question.
nagmon_solar_outer_grey_hood_card1: First card, Neptune: the planet farthest from the Sun, with very strong winds.
nagmon_solar_outer_grey_hood_card2: Second card, Pluto: a dwarf planet, smaller than our Moon, with a heart-shaped region on it.
nagmon_solar_outer_grey_hood_card3: Third card, a comet: a ball of ice and dust. When it comes near the Sun, it grows a tail.
nagmon_solar_outer_grey_hood_good: Right! The cards are yours to remember. Here are 25 coins.
nagmon_solar_outer_owl: Pluto is a dwarf planet. Comets come from the frozen region at the edge of the system. From here the Sun looks like a small star.
nagmon_solar_outer_rover_driver: Probes fly for years to get here. They have no driver, only an antenna that talks to us. Sometimes a signal takes hours to arrive.
nagmon_solar_quiz_free: Right! Well done. The coins for today are all given, but learning is always fun.
nagmon_solar_quiz_good: Right! Here are 3 coins for you.
nagmon_solar_quiz_mission_wrong: No problem! Now we saw the answer. You can come back and try again whenever you like.
nagmon_solar_quiz_wrong: No problem! Now we saw the answer. Next time it will be easier.
nagmon_solar_rocky_planets_owl: Mercury is closest to the Sun, but Venus is the hottest, because of its thick clouds. One day on Venus is longer than its year.
nagmon_solar_rocky_planets_rover_driver: I drive a rover on Mars. The ground there is red, because it holds rusty iron. Mars has a giant volcano called Olympus.
nagmon_solar_rocky_planets_rover_driver_: Want to ride with me? There are three stops on the way, and a question at each stop.
We made it! A fine drive. Here are 15 coins.
The road was a little bumpy, but we learned on the way. We can drive again whenever you like.
nagmon_solar_rocky_planets_sage: The first four planets are rocky: Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars. They have hard ground. Earth is the only place we know that has life.
nagmon_solar_station_astronomer: Welcome to the space station! The telescope shows faraway stars. The light of some of them travelled to us for many years.
nagmon_solar_station_astronomer_how: There are five places: the Moon, near the Sun, the rocky planets, the giants and the edge. Each place opens when your strongest friend reaches a certain level, and the trip costs coins. A place is done when you finish its mission there and also catch three creatures there. When all five are done, the astronomer test waits in the trips menu. Whoever passes it gets the badge.
nagmon_solar_station_astronomer_ready: All five missions are done! If you caught three creatures in every place, you can open the trips menu and take the astronomer test.
nagmon_solar_station_mila: Eight planets go around the Sun, and Earth is one of them. Earth goes around the Sun once a year. In space there is no up or down, so astronauts float.
nagmon_solar_sun_grey_hood: The Sun is so big that more than a million Earths would fit inside it. Its light takes about eight minutes to reach us.
nagmon_solar_sun_grey_hood_filter: I found a strange filter in the fog. Maybe it is the owl's? Please take it to him.
nagmon_solar_sun_owl: The Sun is a star: a giant ball of hot gas. Never look straight at the Sun. Look only through a special filter, with a grown-up.
nagmon_solar_sun_owl_ask: My shield filter got lost in the fog! Without it we cannot watch the Sun safely. Maybe the woman in the grey hood found it?
nagmon_solar_sun_owl_found: That is my filter! Thank you. A filter like this protects the eyes, and without it we do not look at the Sun. I have one more question for you.
nagmon_solar_sun_owl_good: Right! Here are 12 coins, and thank you for finding the filter.
nagmon_solar_sun_owl_wait: We have not found my filter yet. Try asking the woman in the grey hood.
nagmon_too_many_players: There are already 8 players. Delete one in the parent area to add a new one.
nagmon_world_cashier_free:
Exactly! You counted right.
You already helped me a lot today. Thank you!
nagmon_world_cashier_good:
Exactly! You counted right, and the till is in order.
Thank you! Here are 20 coins for your help.
nagmon_world_cashier_hello:
Avi: Hello! I'm counting the money in the till.
Can you help me with a little sum?
nagmon_world_cashier_wrong:
Almost! With money it helps to count slowly, coin after coin.
You can try again whenever you like.
nagmon_world_chest_empty_daily: The chest is empty for now. Tomorrow there will be something new!
nagmon_world_chest_empty_once: This chest is already open, and the prize is yours.
nagmon_world_egg_full: Eggs are already warming. When they hatch, there will be room for more.
nagmon_world_egg_none: You have no egg right now. You can find one in a chest.
nagmon_world_egg_placed: The egg is somewhere warm! Every right answer warms it a little.
nagmon_world_friend_neighbor:
Neighbour: Hello, and welcome to my house!
Come again soon.
nagmon_world_gardener_free:
Right! Learning together is fun.
The garden is blooming today.
nagmon_world_gardener_good:
Right! You looked closely at the world.
Here is a wood berry from the garden, for you.
nagmon_world_gardener_hello:
Michal: Hello! My garden is full of questions.
Can you help me with a science question?
nagmon_world_gardener_wrong:
No problem! Scientists make mistakes too, and then they learn.
Come back whenever you like.
nagmon_world_granite_badge: You got the Stone Badge and 100 coins!
nagmon_world_granite_done:
Master Granite: The Stone Badge shines nicely.
Shapes are everywhere. Try looking for them!
nagmon_world_granite_hello:
Master Granite: Welcome to the Granite Academy!
Here we learn shapes: triangles, squares, circles and more.
nagmon_world_granite_lost:
Master Granite: That was a good duel.
Your monsters rested a little. You can try again whenever you like.
nagmon_world_granite_not_yet:
Master Granite: It didn't work out this time, and that's fine.
A mountain is built stone by stone. You can practise with the people in town.
Come back and try again whenever you like.
nagmon_world_granite_pass:
You passed the test! I can see you practised.
Now, a friendly duel. Good luck!
nagmon_world_granite_rematch:
Master Granite: You're back! The test is already behind you.
Let's go on to a friendly duel.
nagmon_world_granite_rules:
Before a friendly duel there is a little test: 3 questions.
Two right answers are enough. There is no clock. Let's begin!
nagmon_world_granite_won:
Master Granite: An excellent duel!
You thought about every step, like someone building a stone house.
nagmon_world_granny_happy:
Grandma Rina: Thanks again for the wallet.
My grandchildren say hello!
nagmon_world_granny_hello:
Grandma Rina: Hello, ${{name}}!
What a lovely day for a walk in town.
nagmon_world_granny_later: Grandma Rina: All right. If the wallet turns up, I'll be very happy.
nagmon_world_granny_lost:
Grandma Rina: Oh, I lost my wallet.
It has a photo of my grandchildren...
nagmon_world_granny_reward: Grandma Rina gives you 30 coins and a water berry from her garden.
nagmon_world_granny_thanks:
Grandma Rina: My wallet! I looked for it all morning.
You brought it back, even when nobody was watching. That is honesty.
nagmon_world_granny_value:
Honesty helps everyone feel safe.
Thank you so much!
nagmon_world_home_pet: Purr! Your little friend is happy you are home.
nagmon_world_kid_happy:
Yoav: Pitzi and I play all day.
Thanks for helping!
nagmon_world_kid_lost:
Yoav: Oh no... my kitten, Pitzi, ran away!
She ran north to Route 1, past the tall grass.
Can you help me find her?
nagmon_world_kid_reward: Yoav gives you 2 potions and 30 coins.
nagmon_world_kid_thanks:
Yoav: Pitzi! You found her! Thank you so much!
You went all the way to Route 1 for a friend. That is real kindness.
nagmon_world_kid_waiting:
Yoav: Pitzi ran to Route 1.
She is on the left side, past the tall grass.
nagmon_world_kitten_found:
Meow! Pitzi purrs.
She jumps into your arms. Now you can bring her back to Yoav.
nagmon_world_lab_tutor:
Tutor: Welcome to the learning room!
Soon there will be questions and tips here.
nagmon_world_mila_badge: You got the Number Badge and 100 coins!
nagmon_world_mila_done:
Master Mila: The Number Badge is shining!
Numbers hide everywhere: in the shop, on the clock, on the road.
nagmon_world_mila_hello:
Master Mila: Welcome to the Mila Academy!
Here we practise math: adding, taking away and more.
nagmon_world_mila_lost:
Master Mila: That was a good duel.
Your monsters rested a little. You can try again whenever you like.
nagmon_world_mila_not_yet:
Master Mila: It didn't work out this time, and that's fine.
Every number we practise gets easier.
Come back and try again whenever you like.
nagmon_world_mila_pass:
You passed the test! You worked it out patiently.
Now, a friendly duel. Good luck!
nagmon_world_mila_rematch:
Master Mila: You're back! The test is already behind you.
Let's go on to a friendly duel.
nagmon_world_mila_rules:
Before a friendly duel there is a little test: 3 math questions.
Two right answers are enough. There is no clock. Let's begin!
nagmon_world_mila_won:
Master Mila: An excellent duel!
Every step was well thought out.
nagmon_world_rest_nurse:
Nurse Dana: Welcome to the Rest Center!
You can rest here any time.
nagmon_world_shop_keeper:
Avi: Welcome to the shop!
Pick what you like, and we will pay together.
nagmon_world_sign_tree:
Sign: TREE = a tree
A tree gives shade, fruit and a home for birds.
TREE. Now this word is yours!
nagmon_world_tourist_free:
Thank you! See you!
Tom is happy to practise with you.
nagmon_world_tourist_good:
Thank you very much!
You helped Tom understand. Tom gives you a potion.
nagmon_world_tourist_hello:
Hello! I am Tom. I am a tourist.
(Tom is visiting. He speaks English.)
Let's help him with some English!
nagmon_world_tourist_wrong:
Good try!
Now we saw the answer. Next time it will be easier.
nagmon_world_trainer_done:
Danny: A tip from a mail carrier: a question before a move = a strong move.
Good luck at the academy!
nagmon_world_trainer_hello:
Danny: Hi! I deliver letters, and I train on my break.
Want a friendly duel? Just for fun.
nagmon_world_trainer_later: Danny: Sure. I'm here all day.
nagmon_world_trainer_lost:
Danny: That was a good duel!
Your monsters rested a little. We can duel again whenever you like.
nagmon_world_trainer_won:
Danny: What a nice duel!
My monsters got tired, but they had lots of fun.
nagmon_world_wallet_found:
You found a wallet on the sidewalk!
There is a note inside: "Grandma Rina's".
What do we do with the wallet?
nagmon_world_wallet_kept:
The wallet is in the bag.
Hmm... maybe someone is looking for it right now.
nagmon_world_wallet_return:
The wallet is in the bag, on its way to Grandma Rina.
She lives on the east side of the street.
nepbit_description: A blue droplet. Neptune is very far from the Sun, so its light is dim.
nepdart_description: A fast wave fish. Neptune has the strongest winds in the Solar System.
nepstorm_description: A stormy ray. A year on Neptune lasts about 165 Earth years.
orbitail_description: It circles without stopping. The planets orbit the Sun because of its gravity.
orbs_description: The user fires off an energy ball that causes a mystical transformation in the target.
plutaur_description: A tiger of the cold. Pluto is very far away, and very cold.
plutopaw_description: A cat on the ice. Pluto has a big heart-shaped region.
plutot_description: A cute little ball. Pluto is a dwarf planet.
probewing_description: A probe with solar wings. Probes are sent to faraway planets.
probip_description: A little probe, a spacecraft with no people, carrying a camera and instruments.
ram_description: The user charges forward with incredible force, delivering a devastating physical blow.
release_confirmation: Are you sure you would like to release {name}?
rift_dash_description: The user creates a temporary rift in space and dash through it, reappearing at a different location and striking the opponent with a swift attack.
rift_dash_fail: {user} fails to teleport, leaving itself open to attack!
ringlet_description: A little ball with a ring. Saturn is surrounded by rings.
ringwarden_description: It guards the shining rings. Saturn has more than a hundred moons.
roverex_description: A Mars rover. Rovers study rocks and soil with no person aboard.
roveroo_description: A little rover on wheels. Rovers drive across planets and take pictures.
ruby_description: The user fires a concentrated beam of ruby-like energy, inflicting damage.
rustip_description: A red ball of rust. Mars is red, because it has a lot of rusty iron.
sailbit_description: A tiny sail of light. Sunlight can push a spacecraft.
sailray_description: A wide, light sail. A solar sail needs no fuel.
saturnip_description: A beetle with rings. Saturn's rings are made of chunks of ice and rock.
shapechange_description: The user undergoes a rapid transformation, striking the opponent with a surprising and powerful attack.
solwind_description: A small green breeze. The solar wind is a stream of particles flowing from the Sun.
starfall_description: A shower of celestial bodies descends upon the opponent, inflicting damage and granting the user heightened focus while exhausting the opponent.
struggle_description: They fight back with raw instinct when no other options remain.
taste_bland_description: A vague, chalky taste, like powdered mashed potatoes made with a sigh instead of water.
taste_dry_description: A parched, dusty flavor, like stale crackers that dull your senses.
taste_flakey_description: A crumbly, light flavor, like dry pastry that makes your aim waver.
taste_hearty_description: A rich, earthy taste, like dense bread that fortifies your defenses.
taste_mild_description: A gentle, calming flavor, like warm milk that slows the world around you.
taste_peppy_description: A burst of fizzy energy, like popping candy that makes you twitch with anticipation.
taste_refined_description: A subtle, elegant taste, like fine tea that sharpens your reflexes.
taste_salty_description: A briny taste, like seawater on a storm-tossed deck, that strengthens your resolve.
taste_savory_description: A rich, slow-roasted flavor, like smoky mushrooms and caramelized onions that settle warmly in your core.
taste_soft_description: A delicate, airy flavor, like whipped cream that leaves you feeling vulnerable.
taste_sweet_description: A cloying, sugary flavor, like melted candy that makes your limbs heavy.
taste_zesty_description: A sharp, tangy taste, like citrus sparks that ignite your focus.
technique_description: ID.{id} ({types}) - Accuracy {acc}%, Potency {pot}%, Power {pow}/3, Recharge {rec} turns
terrabub_description: A blue and green ball. Earth is the only place we know that has life.
terratot_description: A little turtle carrying a world on its back. Most of Earth is covered by water.
terravault_description: A calm, sturdy guardian. Earth's air protects us from space.
tiltip_description: A blue, tilted ball. Uranus spins almost on its side.
tiltitan_description: A calm ice giant. Uranus is one of the coldest planets.
time_crisis_description: The user distorts the flow of time, causing the opponent damage.
titanewt_description: A small newt. Titan has lakes of liquid methane.
titanip_description: A hazy orange ball. Titan is a moon of Saturn, and it has thick air.
titanveil_description: Wrapped in orange haze. Titan has mountains and lakes under its haze.
tuxeball_ancient_description: This Tuxeball was made a long time ago and is capable of catching any Tuxemon without fail.
tuxeball_candy_description: Captures Tuxemon and increases its level by one upon capture.
tuxeball_crusher_description: This Tuxeball breaks through defenses and increases the catch rate the higher the opposing Tuxemon's defense is. It will fail to catch if a protective condition is in place.
tuxeball_diurnal_description: Captures more easily during daytime, but its effectiveness is significantly reduced during the night.
tuxeball_earth_description: Captures more easily an Earth Tuxemon.
tuxeball_female_description: Captures more easily a Female Tuxemon.
tuxeball_fire_description: Captures more easily a Fire Tuxemon.
tuxeball_gambler_description: This tuxeball is known for its unpredictable nature. Its catch rate fluctuates wildly, with the chance of capturing a tuxemon ranging from extremely low to exceptionally high.
tuxeball_grand_description: Offers an even higher capture rate than the Lavish Tuxeball.
tuxeball_hardened_description: Captures Tuxemon and it doesn't break when it fails.
tuxeball_hearty_description: Upon capture, the tuxemon's positive taste changes to hearty.
tuxeball_lavish_description: Boasts a significantly higher capture rate than the Noble Tuxeball.
tuxeball_majestic_description: The ultimate choice for catching even the most elusive tuxemon.
tuxeball_male_description: Captures more easily a Male Tuxemon.
tuxeball_metal_description: Captures more easily a Metal Tuxemon.
tuxeball_neuter_description: Captures more easily a Neuter Tuxemon.
tuxeball_noble_description: A moderate upgrade to the standard Tuxeball.
tuxeball_nocturnal_description: Captures more easily during nighttime, but its effectiveness is significantly reduced during the day.
tuxeball_omni_description: This odd Tuxeball increases the chance of succeeding if the opposing Tuxemon is the same type as yours, but has a decreased chance if they are different types.
tuxeball_park_description: The official Park capture device. It only works inside the Park.
tuxeball_peppy_description: Upon capture, the tuxemon's positive taste changes to peppy.
tuxeball_refined_description: Upon capture, the tuxemon's positive taste changes to refined.
tuxeball_salty_description: Upon capture, the tuxemon's positive taste changes to salty.
tuxeball_water_description: Captures more easily a Water Tuxemon.
tuxeball_wood_description: Captures more easily a Wood Tuxemon.
tuxeball_xero_description: This odd Tuxeball increases the chance of succeeding if the opposing Tuxemon is a different type than yours, but has a decreased chance if they are the same type.
tuxeball_zesty_description: Upon capture, the tuxemon's positive taste changes to zesty.
uranurtle_description: A swimmer tilted to one side, circling a ring. Uranus is an ice giant.
venubud_description: A soft yellow cloud. Venus is wrapped in thick clouds.
venumoth_description: A cloud moth. Venus is very hot, because its clouds trap the heat.
venuveil_description: Its wings are like a veil of clouds. Venus spins slowly, and backwards.
zodiacat_description: A cat of soft light. Zodiacal light is a faint glow of dust in space.
